acts.name: Foundation
acts.title: The Water We Share
acts.theme: Scarcity, blame, local knowledge, unavoidable loss
acts.endState: Alya becomes Brackenford's recognized leader; first facility and Expedition unlock.

acts.name: Construction
acts.title: A Place for the Uncounted
acts.theme: Growth, integration, delegated responsibility, institutional rupture
acts.endState: Brackenford shelters people under a documented risk plan and establishes council governance.

acts.name: Consequences
acts.title: The Cost of Being Free
acts.theme: Autonomy, scarcity, trade leverage, plural regional agreements
acts.endState: Three regions ratify a voluntary mutual-aid compact.

acts.name: Escalation
acts.title: What the Wound Learns
acts.theme: Systemic exploitation, verification, delegation under pressure
acts.endState: The network survives in a changed form; evidence points toward the Wound's Confluence.

acts.name: Revelation and Resolution
acts.title: A Future Without a Center
acts.theme: Truth, distributed responsibility, uncertain but durable recovery
acts.endState: The Ferida's sustaining conditions are transformed or constrained; epilogues follow world state.

mainQuests.title: The Empty Cistern
mainQuests.objective: Meet Mara and the First Ally; establish the water dispute.

mainQuests.title: A Ration Is Not a History
mainQuests.objective: Learn that unequal allocation predates the Red Thread.

mainQuests.title: Signs Beneath the Water
mainQuests.objective: Investigate the moving filaments without overclaiming their origin.

mainQuests.title: A Door Left Open
mainQuests.objective: Stabilize an affected resident and choose a water-sharing priority.

mainQuests.title: The Cost of a Quick Fix
mainQuests.objective: Discover that the sluice can be repaired but the seed reserve cannot be saved.

mainQuests.title: The Organization Arrives
mainQuests.objective: Receive and assess the containment proposal.

mainQuests.title: Three Parts of a Third Option
mainQuests.objective: Gather repair materials, local knowledge and coordinated care.

mainQuests.title: Hold the Sluice
mainQuests.objective: Complete diversion, filament and gate objectives.

mainQuests.title: What Remains
mainQuests.objective: Record seed loss, downstream protection and community costs.

mainQuests.title: A Place That Must Continue
mainQuests.objective: Recognize Alya as leader and choose an initial facility.

mainQuests.title: First Delegation
mainQuests.objective: Launch and resolve the first autonomous Expedition.

mainQuests.title: A Roof for Strangers
mainQuests.objective: Convert temporary shelter into a permanent refuge.

mainQuests.title: The Work Nobody Sees
mainQuests.objective: Assign residents to care, gathering, training and maintenance.

mainQuests.title: The Ledger of Needs
mainQuests.objective: Create a transparent resource ledger and prioritize a shortage.

mainQuests.title: A Place at the Table
mainQuests.objective: Resolve a mediation arc and establish a resident voice.

mainQuests.title: The Shape of a Promise
mainQuests.objective: Define the scope and review conditions of Alya's public promise.

mainQuests.title: A Road with Two Names
mainQuests.objective: Open Greenwake Basin and negotiate local access.

mainQuests.title: The Pilot Community
mainQuests.objective: Negotiate Organization reporting and supervision terms.

mainQuests.title: The People Marked for Moving
mainQuests.objective: Investigate the relocation order and hear affected residents.

mainQuests.title: The Order We Refuse
mainQuests.objective: Shelter the group with a documented risk plan; formalize council governance.

mainQuests.title: Freedom Has a Price
mainQuests.objective: Choose an economic stabilization policy after support guarantees end.

mainQuests.title: The Glassstep Contract
mainQuests.objective: Negotiate a trade compact with quotas, exceptions and dispute clauses.

mainQuests.title: The Empty Caravan
mainQuests.objective: Investigate a missing shipment and identify the incentive failure.

mainQuests.title: Two Fires, One River
mainQuests.objective: Mediate a resource dispute with no cost-free outcome.

mainQuests.title: A Different Kind of Kinship
mainQuests.objective: Enter Mycelian Reach and negotiate with its leaders.

mainQuests.title: What the Roots Remember
mainQuests.objective: Choose consent and reciprocity terms for shared memory.

mainQuests.title: The Price of a Cure
mainQuests.objective: Allocate scarce treatment and research access.

mainQuests.title: A Voice from the Organization
mainQuests.objective: Cooperate with an internal reformer while protecting local authority.

mainQuests.title: The Compact of Three Regions
mainQuests.objective: Ratify the mutual-aid compact with explicit local exceptions.

mainQuests.title: When the Signals Lie
mainQuests.objective: Verify a manipulated warning and establish redundancy.

mainQuests.title: The Cinderfall Evacuation
mainQuests.objective: Evacuate civilians with limited transport and time.

mainQuests.title: The Measure of a Life
mainQuests.objective: Challenge a triage protocol that hides value judgments.

mainQuests.title: The Delegates Disagree
mainQuests.objective: Resolve a council crisis without Alya simply overruling delegates.

mainQuests.title: The Broken Route
mainQuests.objective: Restore a regional corridor through direct action and an Expedition.

mainQuests.title: A Familiar Mistake
mainQuests.objective: Alya over-centralizes; allies and delegates must take responsibility.

mainQuests.title: The Shattered Archive
mainQuests.objective: Enter the archive and gather records from multiple sources.

mainQuests.title: The Wound Learns
mainQuests.objective: Discover how the Ferida exploits systems and feedback loops.

mainQuests.title: The Network Under Fire
mainQuests.objective: Defend multiple objectives; prior regional preparation changes support.

mainQuests.title: The Promise Alya Buried
mainQuests.objective: Reconstruct Alya's prior failure from evidence and testimony.

mainQuests.title: The Personification
mainQuests.objective: Confront the Ferida Manipulator's interpretation of the wound.

mainQuests.title: The Coalition's Terms
mainQuests.objective: Negotiate a final coalition with explicit costs and local authority.

mainQuests.title: A Road Without a Hero
mainQuests.objective: Assign final responsibilities to allies, delegates and regions.

mainQuests.title: Into the Confluence
mainQuests.objective: Reach the final region; optional paths affect support, not access.

mainQuests.title: The Wound's Heart
mainQuests.objective: Disrupt the manifestation's anchors in the first final phase.

mainQuests.title: The Last Pattern
mainQuests.objective: Maintain coalition links and stop the feedback loop.

mainQuests.title: What We Leave Running
mainQuests.objective: Choose which structures are preserved, reformed, decentralized or retired.

mainQuests.title: A Future Without a Center
mainQuests.objective: Resolve ending family and character epilogues.
